spec.name: Orange Kitchen Strawberry Milkshake
spec.description: A tall strawberry-pink milkshake in a stepped ivory paper cup, crowned with swirled whipped cream, a fresh strawberry and a bent striped straw. Rounded cup facets and warm ceramic-like trim give the silhouette a cohesive vanilla kitchen style. Ground contact is y=0.

elements.name: Milkshake surface and rolled cup collar

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Strawberry Milkshake. Tall stepped glass or paper milkshake cup, appropriate drink color, straw and whipped cream if the recipe calls for cream. Actual recipe ingredients: strawberry, cream, milk bucket. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
